subject: subj01
data_kind_legend: REAL_DATA = computed on real subj01 betas; REAL_DATA_STRUCTURAL = code/provenance audit on the real pipeline; FIXTURE controls are in CI.

01_cue_leakage.check: decoder input is ROI betas only; cue letter never enters the prediction path
01_cue_leakage.evidence: extract_imagery_rows returns only voxel betas at frozen ROI coords; decoder.predict takes betas -> frozen z-score -> frozen weights. No cue, target, category, caption, or candidate rank is passed.

02_target_metadata_leakage.evidence: target identity is used ONLY post-hoc to score retrieval, never in predict()

03_row_mapping_leakage.check: row->trial mapping derived from design matrix + behavioral logs, not from decoding
03_row_mapping_leakage.evidence: certified in C3_NSDIMAGERY_ROW_MAPPING_AMENDMENT.md (onset-order proof, 96/96 FRAMEFILE agreement) independent of any decoder output

04_prediction_collapse.check: predictions must not collapse to a single candidate

result.interpretation: Predictions collapse onto a single candidate for a majority of trials -> no genuine stimulus-specific transfer; any permutation-test significance is an artifact of one true stimulus coinciding with the collapse target.

04_prediction_collapse.interpretation: This is the load-bearing falsification: it identifies the imagery 'significance' as a collapse artifact.

05_matched_random_low_rank_transport.check: fitted transport must beat a matched random low-rank transform
05_matched_random_low_rank_transport.evidence: see results/c3_state_transport_realdata.json: no fitted method beats random_low_rank on held-out targets

06_generator_free.check: no image generation / diffusion / reconstruction used anywhere in C3
06_generator_free.evidence: retrieval-only pipeline; no generative model imported or invoked

07_secondary_setA_and_conceptual_setC.check: Set A simple imagery secondary (OOD), Set C conceptual excluded from retrieval
07_secondary_setA_and_conceptual_setC.evidence: Set A exact-p=0.3125 (null); Set C has no ground-truth image and is excluded

uncertainty_h5.note: With degenerate collapse, predictions are near-constant across stimuli, so per-stimulus repeat variance carries no usable error signal; uncertainty calibration is not meaningful and is not claimed. Reported for completeness.
